If you want a pocket-friendly device without the upkeep, Sour Apple FUME PRO 30K is built for exactly that. Fume pairs a pre-filled pod with a built-in battery so you can focus on flavor — here, orchard-fruit sweetness with a gentle, familiar taste.

Sour Apple FUME PRO 30K is listed at $12.49 in our Disposable Vapes range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Disposable Vapes](/shop/disposables/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Sour Apple points to orchard-fruit sweetness with a gentle, familiar taste, with playful candy sweetness with a sour-sweet pop. Descriptions like this are a guide to the intended profile; your own experience will depend on your setup and preferences.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Fume
- **Category:** Disposable Vapes
- **Flavor:** Sour Apple
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Capacity:** 30,000 Puffs
- **Price:** $12.49
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Mesh-style coil technology:** helps spread heat evenly across the coil, which supports consistent flavor through the life of the device.
- **Compact, lightweight body:** slips into a pocket without the bulk of a refillable kit.
- **Large pre-filled capacity:** means fewer replacements and less packaging, which suits adults who vape through the day.
- **Built-in battery:** removes the need for separate cells or chargers, which keeps the device compact enough for a pocket or bag.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Sour Apple FUME PRO 30K suits adult nicotine users who want a simple, ready-to-use device, travelers who prefer something that fits in a pocket, and anyone trying a new flavor before committing to a larger setup.

## Using and caring for it
Use the device only as directed on the packaging. Take gentle, short puffs rather than long, hard draws, which helps the coil keep up and avoids a burnt taste. Keep it upright when you are not using it, store it at room temperature away from direct sunlight and hot cars, and do not try to open, refill or modify it. When the flavor fades or the battery stops responding, dispose of it according to local rules for electronics and batteries. Keep it away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Sour Apple FUME PRO 30K online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by USPS or UPS. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
